page_title: LEV 0-2 VAL | Levante v Valencia 15/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Was it necessary? Kervin Arriaga (Levante) is shown a second yellow card for dissent and has to leave the pitch. Miguel Ortiz had no hesitation in issuing a red card!
90+5' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+4' Carlos Espi (Levante) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90+2' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul.
90+1' Carlos Espi (Levante) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
88' Here is a change. Largie Ramazani is going off and Carlos Corberan gives the last tactical orders to Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).
88' Problems for Carlos Corberan as Eray Comert is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia) replaces him.
85' Matias Moreno (Levante) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
85' The game is interrupted now, Eray Comert (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
85' 0 - 2 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Umar Sadiq (Valencia) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 0:2.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Paco Cortes (Levante) comes onto the pitch so that Nacho Perez can be given a rest.
78' Luis Castro has decided to substitute Pablo Martinez Andres and he is replaced by Unai Vencedor (Levante).
76' Dela (Levante) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.
74' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
73' Poor challenge! Guido Rodriguez (Valencia) is penalised for tripping and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle.
73' The attendance for today's match is 22967.
69' We are about to witness a substitution. Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) is replacing Iker Losada.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Carlos Espi (Levante) will replace Ivan Romero.
69' Luis Castro decides to make a substitution. Carlos Alvarez will be replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante).
67' Half-chance! Luis Rioja (Valencia) plays a pass into the box, but Mathew Ryan reacts well to snuff out the attack.

64' 0 - 1 Brilliant finish! Largie Ramazani (Valencia) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Luis Rioja, then produced a nice strike into the top left corner. The score is 0:1.
58' Carlos Corberan has decided to make a change. Javi Guerra (Valencia) replaces Filip Ugrinic.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Umar Sadiq (Valencia) comes onto the pitch for Hugo Duro.
58' We are about to witness a subsitution. Guido Rodriguez (Valencia) for Pepelu.
58' Unai Nunez (Valencia) sends a chip pass into the box, but Mathew Ryan is quickest to intercept the ball.
51' A rebound bounces out to Kareem Tunde (Levante) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
50' Ivan Romero (Levante) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Miguel Ortiz no option but to blow his whistle.
49' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
48' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. Levante force their opponents to concede a corner.

48' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Corner kick. Levante will have an opportunity.

46' What an opportunity! Dela (Levante) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the resulting free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
46' It seemed like Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
46' The referee blows his whistle as Pepelu (Valencia) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
43' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle. Luis Rioja (Valencia) commits a foul after dangerous play.
41' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
40' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Miguel Ortiz saw the whole situation.
39' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul.
38' Rough tackle by Dela (Levante). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Luis Rioja (Valencia) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
36' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) tackles a bit over-zealously and Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul.
35' Manu Sanchez (Levante) sends a cross into the box, but Stole Dimitrievski comes off his line to gather the ball.
33' The resulting corner from Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) is cleared by the defence.
33' A pass into the penalty area from Iker Losada (Levante) is intercepted by the defence.
29' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
24' Jose Gaya (Valencia) makes a strong challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul.
23' The referee blows his whistle after Kareem Tunde (Levante) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Valencia.
23' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Filip Ugrinic (Valencia), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

22' Luis Rioja (Valencia) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
21' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) takes the corner but it's cleared.
20' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.
17' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Ortiz had an easy-decision to make.

17' Ivan Romero (Levante) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the left post, but Stole Dimitrievski pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
17' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
16' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
15' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
13' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
12' Levante are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
8' Hugo Duro (Valencia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Levante will have a throw-in.
8' Miguel Ortiz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Carlos Alvarez (Levante) and blew his whistle.
7' Good chance! Hugo Duro (Valencia) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
2' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
1' The free kick is delivered by Carlos Alvarez (Levante) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Valencia will kick the game off.
Miguel Ortiz got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
